codes.technical_name: Bonded uplink below keepalive rate while other links carry the stream
codes.rule: Fresh sender samples show this link connected at no more than 1024 bit/s for at least 20 s while another eligible link carries more than 1024 bit/s. Clears once the link sends at least 2048 bit/s, or when it leaves the bond or the stream stops.
codes.note: Not a fault on its own: a bonding sender may starve a link deliberately when others are better. Show it calmly, per link.

codes.technical_name: Capture input stalled while the encoder keeps streaming
codes.rule: Two consecutive health samples, 4.5 to 6.5 s apart, show no new frames from the selected input while streaming. Clears after two good samples, at stream stop, or when the selection changes. Not raised for standby or deliberately synthetic sources.

codes.technical_name: Digital silence in the program audio
codes.rule: The program audio meter shows digital silence for 10 s from fresh meter readings while streaming. A stale or missing meter is unknown, not silence. Not raised when the sound was muted or no audio source was chosen.
codes.note: Likely, not measured: a quiet scene is possible.

codes.technical_name: Encoder fed by the standby source
codes.rule: The encoder is streaming the standby source instead of a camera. Clears when a camera feed returns.

codes.technical_name: Hold-up reserve supplying the host; no healthy input
codes.rule: The power supervisor reports the reserve supplying the host.
The power supervisor reports inputs present but none healthy.

codes.technical_name: Input stood down by the power supervisor
codes.rule: The power supervisor has stood an input down; another input supplies the host.

codes.technical_name: Shutdown requested by the power supervisor
codes.rule: The power supervisor has requested a host shutdown.

codes.technical_name: Power supervisor reports a protection gap
codes.rule: The power supervisor reports at least one protection gap. Unknown gap bits count as reduced protection.

codes.technical_name: Expected power supervisor silent or absent
codes.rule: A power supervisor was seen before on this device and has sent no valid status for 5 s. List the power subject as unknown in checked.
